services.title: Services
services.sub: From QA building processes to AI-assisted QA manual daily routine automation - I tailor every QA process to QA team's real needs and business goals.
services.auditDesc: A thorough review of your testing practices, coverage gaps, and toolchain - with a prioritized action plan tied to business risk.
services.strategyDesc: Building a sustainable, risk-based testing strategy aligned with your product goals, team capacity, and Agile delivery cycle.
services.automationTitle: AI-Driven QA Manual Daily Routine Processes Automation
services.automationDesc: Modernising your daily routine manual stack with AI-assisted tools and techniques - reducing maintenance overhead and accelerating feedback loops.
services.agileDesc: Embedding quality practices into Agile and SAFe workflows - from sprint ceremonies to PI Planning and continuous testing pipelines.
services.processDesc: Building automated tools for QA Reports - Testing results reporting, feature risks triage, QA income testing data generation, important QA metrics - so the QA team spends time on what actually matters.
services.leadershipDesc: Building quality culture - people management, mentoring QA engineers, and helping QA teams own quality as a shared value.

cases.title: Real problems. Real outcomes.
cases.sub: A few examples of how I've helped teams move from quality debt to delivery confidence.
cases.case1Problem: Following a migration to a microservices architecture within the payment services sector, a previously stable monolithic product experienced frequent regressions and production integration bugs after each release, impacting corporate client trust.
cases.case1Approach: Full QA audit, risk-based test prioritization, and a regression suite integrated into the CI/CD pipeline.
cases.case1Outcome: The number of failed releases decreased by 70% over a one-year period. The team established strong confidence in delivering timely updates without resorting to critical backports into the release version.
cases.case2Title: Cutting Release QA Cycle Time from 4 Weeks to 5 Days
cases.case2Problem: Manual testing was a release bottleneck for a growing platform - blocking deployments and extending release QA cycles to up to 4 weeks.
cases.case2Approach: Built a comprehensive product taxonomy with business priorities defined for each feature. Mapped all manual tests, identified API and unit-level automation opportunities, and designed a Playwright-based framework while upskilling the manual QA team.
cases.case2Outcome: Cut release QA cycles from 12 days to 5 days and eliminated a critical process bottleneck by automated risk-based prioritization by product taxonomy according to feature business values for each test suite.
cases.case3Title: Adapting Quality processes into a SAFe
cases.case3Problem: A scale-up transitioning to SAFe had no consistent QA integration across ARTs - quality was an afterthought at PI boundaries.
cases.case3Approach: Defined QA roles within SAFe ceremonies, introduced built-in quality practices, and automated routine reporting across teams.
cases.case3Outcome: Quality metrics became a standard PI objective. Defect escape rate dropped significantly within two program increments.

about.title: Quality isn't a phase - it's a mindset.
about.p1: I'm Yevheniia, a Senior QA Engineer and Strategic QA Lead with 10+ years of experience working across startups, scale-ups, and enterprise teams.
about.p2: I'm passionate about building quality culture - not just finding bugs. My focus is on automating the daily QA routine, enabling teams to move faster without sacrificing confidence, and leading engineers to take genuine ownership of quality.
about.p3: With a background spanning Agile Testing, AI-driven quality operations, and SAFe at scale, I bring both hands-on technical depth and strategic leadership to every engagement.
